connect.title: Connect with the agents
connect.body: The AI agents you choose open in the project folder with a request already typed in. They add Allomos's instructions to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. The first one also looks for tasks the project already keeps (a task board, card files, a to-do list). If it finds some, it shows you its whole plan here, and you decide whether to move them. Nothing is sent until you send it.
connect.first: {agent} also looks for existing tasks; the others only add the instructions.
connect.asked: Opened {agents}. Read the request there and send it. If {first} finds existing tasks, its plan appears here for you to go ahead or cancel.
notice.restart_agents: Just created: {files}. AI agent sessions that were already running in this project have not read it; only new sessions know about Allomos. Start a new session to use it.
welcome.hint: Select a folder where you want to keep your tasks.
wizard.title: Set up a taskbag
wizard.what_body: A taskbag is where Allomos keeps a project's tasks, areas and progress: plain files in a folder named {dir}, kept with your project in Git. You and your AI agents read and change them through Allomos and the alm command.
wizard.choose_hint: Usually your project's own folder: {dir} is created inside it.
wizard.found_body: Allomos will use the taskbag in {path}.
wizard.missing_body: Create {dir} in {folder}? The taskbag starts empty.
wizard.git: It is inside the Git repository {repo}. Your task files will be versioned by that repository; Allomos does not create a second one and does not run Git.
wizard.source_body: The project source folder holds the project's code and documents, and its AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. AI agents work there. Usually it is the folder you chose in step 1.
